What is tankan bhasma 
 Tankan Bhasma is a special Ayurvedic medicine prepared from Borax. This Ayurvedic calcined formulation is used to cure the various complications like bronchitis, abdominal pain, cough, breathing problems, wheezing, dandruff, bad breath, foul-smelling urine and dysmenorrhea. Tankan Bhasma is a very effective Ayurvedic treatment for the lack of menstruation in females. This Ayurvedic preparation helps to balance the vata and kapha doshas. 
 Tankan Bhasma Ingredients 
 Sodium borate 
 Method of Tankan Bhasma Preparation 
 Tankan Bhasma – Prepared from Sodium borate. The raw borax is first purified and then subjected to controlled heating to remove moisture. It is further heated until it transforms into a white, dry, amorphous powder, which is the final Bhasma form used for medicinal purposes. 
 Tankan Bhasma Dosage 
 125 mg to 250 mg of this Bhasma is taken daily along with honey and ghee. 
 Tankan Bhasma Uses and Benefits 

 Use of this medicine is quite effective to treat female health complications. It helps to induce menstruation in women suffering with amenorrhea or oligomenorrhea (Scanty menstrual flow). It helps to improve menstrual flow. 
 It is used to treat respiratory complications like cough, bronchitis, wheezing, asthma and chest congestion. 
 It is helpful to treat urinary infections. 
 It is good, quite good to improve the digestion power and also relieves the bloating. 
 It cures bad breath. 
 This medicine is used in the treatment of food poisoning and abdominal colic pain. 
 It is used to cure the skin sores. 
 It is helpful to treat viral infections of skin like hand foot and mouth disorder. 

 Tankan Bhasma Side Effects 

 Use of this increases Pitta and hence leads to the burning sensation in few people. So caution should be taken while administering this medicine in the case of gastritis and peptic ulcer patients. 
 Tankan Bhasma should be avoided during pregnancy. 
 Take this medicine during the lactation period only under medical supervision. 
 Long term usage of this medicine can cause oligospermia. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
